text: Derive an expression for g at a height h above the Earth’s surface, and approximate it for small h.

points.text: At the surface, g = GM/R².
At height h, g_h = GM/(R + h)².
So g_h = g(R/(R + h))² = g(1 + h/R)⁻².
For small h, g_h ≈ g(1 − 2h/R).
